Name: Make Gunther (and Cecily) Nyapu
Author: amillionand1fandoms
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Replace Gunther and Cecily's portraits with portraits in the style of Nyapu. Meant to be used alongside Make Gunther Real and won't work without it. 

There are a number of portraits of Gunther by Nyapu already, but this edit is necessary because the order of emotions on the portrait sheet aren't the same in other mods that make Gunther a real NPC. (And I haven't seen anyone do a Nyapu Cecily at all.)

Currently this just has the normal portraits. My future plans include making seasonal portraits for both Gunther and Cecily and making edits to their sprites to better match Slightly Cuter Characters.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Extract it from the .zip and put it in your mods folder.
If you have other mods that replace Gunther's portrait (For example, Slightly Cuter Characters) you should turn off Gunther in those mods.
